We're not just real estate agents. We're your neighbors, your advocates, and the team that truly cares about your next chapter.
We didn't just build a real estate company. We built a set of beliefs that guide every conversation, every offer, and every key we hand over.
We believe that honesty isn't just the best policy — it's the only policy. In an industry where fine print and fast talk are too common, we choose a different path.
No filters. No fluff. Just why I started this — and why I still show up every day.
I'll be honest with you — I didn't grow up dreaming of selling homes.

I watched too many good people get lost in confusing contracts and pushy sales tactics. Real estate shouldn't feel like that. So I built Shelta to be different — honest, human, and genuinely helpful. Every agent on our team has skill and heart. Because you deserve both.
Hundreds of successful closings across every property type — from first-time buyer homes to luxury estates.
Genuine smiles, lifelong relationships, from homeowners who felt supported every step of the way.
Decades of navigating market shifts, negotiation tables, and complex contracts — so you don't have to.
Finding the right property is simple. With our platform, you can search thousands of verified listings.

Find your dream home with confidence. Explore verified listings, compare neighborhoods, and get expert guidance every step of the way — ensuring you make the right choice for your lifestyle and budget.

Sell your property with confidence. Get a free market valuation, professional staging advice, and strategic pricing that attracts serious buyers — ensuring you maximize value and close on your timeline.

Find your next rental with confidence. Browse verified listings, compare amenities and locations, and get expert support through applications and leases — ensuring you secure a space that truly fits your life.
Lease your property with confidence. Attract quality tenants with professional marketing, thorough screening, and clear agreements — ensuring steady income and peace of mind for the long term.

Buy at auction with confidence. Access upcoming auctions, review property details, and get expert bidding strategies before you raise your paddle — ensuring you win the right property at the right price.
Years of market experience, deep neighborhood knowledge, and a commitment to making your real estate journey as smooth and stress-free as possible.

We're with you from first to final handshake.

Let's Be Real for a Second

Buying a home can feel like everyone else knows a secret you don't. Pre-approvals. Contingencies. Closing costs. Earnest money. It's enough to make your head spin. But here's the truth: it's not that complicated once someone explains it in plain English. So let's do that.
The Number You Actually Need to Know First

Before you fall in love with a kitchen island or a clawfoot tub, get real about your finances. Your credit score isn't just a number — it's the difference between a good interest rate and a great one.
And your budget isn't just the listing price — it's the down payment, closing costs, moving truck, and that first unexpected repair. Run the numbers first. Fall in love second.
Why "Just Looking" Costs You Nothing but Time
A lot of buyers wait until they're "ready" to start touring homes. That's backward. The best way to understand what you actually want is to walk through houses — even ones you think you won't buy.
You'll learn what you love, what you hate, and what you never even thought about. And the best part? Looking is free.
The Pre-Approval Letter Is Your Golden Ticket
Here's something most buyers don't realize: in a competitive market, your charming personality won't win the house. The seller wants proof you can actually pay for it.
A pre-approval letter from a lender says, "We've checked. This buyer is serious." Get it before you make a single offer. Not getting it is like showing up to a race without shoes.
Your Agent Should Feel Like a Teammate, Not a Salesperson

You're about to spend weeks or months with this person. Choose someone who listens more than they talk, answers your late-night texts, and explains things without making you feel silly. A great agent doesn't just open doors — they spot red flags, negotiate like a pro, and celebrate with you when you finally get those keys. Don't settle for less.

You'll learn what you love, what you hate, and what you never even thought about. And the best part? Looking is free.
The Pre-Approval Letter Is Your Golden Ticket
Here's something most buyers don't realize: in a competitive market, your charming personality won't win the house. The seller wants proof you can actually pay for it.
A pre-approval letter from a lender says, "We've checked. This buyer is serious." Get it before you make a single offer. Not getting it is like showing up to a race without shoes.
Your Agent Should Feel Like a Teammate, Not a Salesperson

You're about to spend weeks or months with this person. Choose someone who listens more than they talk, answers your late-night texts, and explains things without making you feel silly. A great agent doesn't just open doors — they spot red flags, negotiate like a pro, and celebrate with you when you finally get those keys. Don't settle for less.
